messages:
Connor (Sales): Quick handoff for OliveBridge (mid-market). 12mo Dedicated, needs VPC peering, customer KMS, SCIM provisioning. Signed but procurement may delay KMS. I filed intake CS-9021. Can CS own onboarding and loop Eng/Support? :handshake:
Meera (CS): Taking it. Immediate asks: billing contact, Okta admin email, and CIDR ranges. Also need any compliance notes (HIPAA/PII)?
Connor (Sales): Billing: marta@olivebridge.com. Okta admin: id-admin@olivebridge.com. CIDR by COB tomorrow. No HIPAA but they do handle sensitive customer data, ask for privacy review.
Ethan (Eng): For SCIM/SSO, we'll need Okta metadata and SCIM settings. Estimate 3-5 business days for validation + tests on Dedicated. Creating ENG-9802. Please include expected traffic profile (qps, avg seq len).
Rosa (Support): I'll draft onboarding runbook and monitoring checklist, add 95/99 latency alerts and a dashboard template. Creating SUP-5567. Need staging logs and sample prompts for tracing.
ContractBot: Note: customer-managed KMS requires contractual addendum and security review. Expected legal lead time ~10 business days.
Meera (CS): Procurement risk noted. If KMS delayed >2w, propose managed KMS short-term to unblock. Also request Optimize calculate token/unit cost example for monthly projection.
Connor (Sales): I'll press procurement and request cost examples.
Meera (CS): Action items: create kickoff invite (Thu 11am PT), build Notion runbook, attach CS-9021, ENG-9802, SUP-5567, request cost projection from Optimize, collect metadata and CIDR. Owners: Meera (CS) lead, Ethan (Eng) ENG-9802, Rosa (Support) SUP-5567, Connor (Sales) procurement. Next update after kickoff. :thumbsup:
